text.description_html:
KW-JPSTD2 Mul-T-Lock Double Cylinder Jimmy Proof Deadlock

Jimmy proof apartment locks, aka New York City Apartment Locks, because of their wide uses on front apartment doors in the big apple. They prevent the door from being "Jimmied" open (pried open) with a crow bar by securely locking your door to the door frame.

Also available: Mul-T-Lock Jimmy Proof Lock and Mul-T-Lock Single Cylinder Jimmy Proof Lock

High security surface mounted deadlock protection combined together with two (2) MUL-T-LOCK high security lock cylinders. Locks by restricted key cylinder outside and inside. Supplied with two (2) keys, owner key card and mounting screws in Bright Brass finish.

Specifications for Mul-T-Lock 206S-JPSTD2 Jimmy Proof Lock

  • UL437 Drill and Pick Resistance
  • Bump Proof Lock Design
  • Mul-T-Lock 206S Security Keyway
  • 2 Keys Included
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Bright Brass Finish
  • Width: 4.49"
  • Height: 2.87"
  • Depth: 1.18"
  • Mul-T-Lock 206S-JPSTD2 Specifications Diagram (PDF)
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty

MUL-T-LOCK's locks are designed to provide superior door protection with uncompromised key control. The Key Card owner is the only person allowed to have the keys duplicated. Remove the worry about anyone making duplicates of your keys.



*This item is Discontinued. Use Mul-T-Lock Single Cylinder Jimmy Proof Lock
